grouping: generation, variant, scenario; full and diagnostic variants never pooled
raw_completeness: Every supplied raw directory must be complete; every present run group must contain exactly the frozen protocol seeds. Missing baseline cells are partial, never silently dropped.
provenance: Validate protocol file SHA256, embedded protocol, run identity and trace SHA256, worker policy fingerprint, frozen producer source hashes, oracle context/reference identities and action-table source hashes.

expected_cost.seed_mean: sum action_count / connections * independently evaluated action minus frozen-reference mean gap; negative estimates retained
expected_cost.seed_interval: Two-sided Student t interval on independent seed means, confidence from protocol.metrics.paired_confidence
expected_cost.shared_mc_bound: sum across context/action of mean action weight across seeds times action gap half-width; no division by sqrt(seed count)
expected_cost.selection_gap_bound: sum across contexts of mean context weight times frozen-reference selection gap upper bound
expected_cost.unresolved: Missing action/reference or unresolved distinct-action zero observed variance yields null bounds and no PASS; no numerical regret is fabricated.
expected_cost.absolute_regret: Reported mean is the estimated gap to the frozen selected reference. True-world optimum regret lies above it by an unknown nonnegative selection gap. Add selection bound only to upper limit.

thresholds.B1_regret_ms: strictly below protocol B1 threshold including seed interval, shared MC and selection bounds
thresholds.B2_regret_ms: strictly below protocol B2 threshold including seed interval, shared MC and selection bounds
thresholds.B1_p_bias: absolute signed pre-decision high-phase tail bias; whole seed interval must lie inside both protocol limits
thresholds.B4_extra_bytes: whole-connection server-counted extra bytes against paired b0, strict protocol limit; first-flight server and client counters remain separate
thresholds.B5_adaptation: Every protocol seed must have a confirmed two-decision near-optimal run starting after at most two new-chain observations. Unknown predicates cannot prove failure or PASS. Report start and confirmation lags, censoring and all-seed distribution.
thresholds.baseline_regression: All full-variant scenario cells must have candidate minus v31 upper limit <= protocol max_regression_vs_v31_ms. No averaging away a bad cell.

trace_metrics.near_optimal: True if action gap upper plus reference selection-gap bound <= protocol adaptation_near_optimal_ms; False if action gap lower exceeds it; otherwise unknown.
trace_metrics.adaptation_index: The first decision after a certificate change has seen zero new-chain observations. Consecutive decisions may not cross the next change boundary.
trace_metrics.suboptimal_episode: Longest consecutive row sequence with action gap lower > protocol adaptation_near_optimal_ms. Unknown rows break confirmed episodes and are reported separately, with a possible-episode upper length.
trace_metrics.fixed_comparators: Read existing trace counterfactual b0 and global fixed(0,3,1) HCT and server-counted bytes, aggregate per seed, retain failures. These realized paired contrasts are diagnostic and are not expected oracle regret.
trace_metrics.transition_display: Show signed p bias, MAE, alarm rate, guard occupancy and detection start/confirmation means. Detection delay means use only detected seeds; show detected denominator, right censoring and prechange-unqualified counts. This display addition does not change thresholds or inference.

direct_baseline_comparison.estimate: For each paired seed, sum differences of candidate and v31 action weights times common action gap estimates. Reference/oracle term cancels because context weights match.
direct_baseline_comparison.shared_mc_bound: Sum absolute mean action-weight differences times action gap half-width. Skip exactly zero coefficients before consulting missing or unresolved action intervals.
direct_baseline_comparison.reference_cancellation: No selection-gap bound added to the direct contrast; reject mismatched context weights.
direct_baseline_comparison.fallback: Realized HCT paired seed difference is a separate diagnostic if expected tables are missing, never substituted for expected regret.

pending: With --allow-pending write status partial, explicit missing artifacts and null unavailable metrics. Without it reject an incomplete report.
inference_scope: Seed Student t intervals are 95%. MC normal bounds are 99% within each oracle context or action job family. Combining these separately scoped bounds does not provide an overall simultaneous 95% guarantee. MC intervals are heuristic, not distribution-free finite-sample guarantees. Reused development seeds and historically held-out cells are not confirmatory evidence.
